comparisons.name: grid-search-light
comparisons.description: The search field on the demo's 1680 by 1050 pt screen against the Aqua Launchpad capture: its place 25 pt from the top, its size, fill and 1 pt border. Masked (12% of the crop): the magnifier and the placeholder, whose text is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms and moves the magnifier beside it. Behind Launchpad in the capture is Apple's desktop picture, blurred: the fixture paints that backdrop behind the crop as measured, and Launchpad's own scrim and blur are off.

comparisons.name: grid-pages-light
comparisons.description: The two page dots, first page current, on the demo's screen against the Aqua Launchpad capture: their place 52 pt above the Dock, which the demo's two pages and the height it keeps clear for its Dock give. Nothing is masked. The backdrop behind the crop is painted by the fixture as measured.

comparisons.name: grid-folder-tile-light
comparisons.description: The folder Other in the 28th place of the grid, with its name under it, against the Aqua Launchpad capture: where the demo's grid puts its fourth row and seventh column, the library's tile, and the name. Masked (43% of the crop): the nine small icons on the tile, which are Apple's artwork in the capture and placeholders in the demo. The name is set in the fallback font and stands about 1.5 pt higher than in the capture. The backdrop is painted by the fixture as measured.

comparisons.name: grid-folder-tile-drawing-light
comparisons.description: As grid-folder-tile-light with the name masked as well (49% of the crop: the nine small icons, Apple's artwork, and the name, which is text in the fallback font), to score the tile alone: its place in the grid, its size, corner and fill, Aqua.

comparisons.name: grid-label-first-light
comparisons.description: The name under the first application, App Store, against the Aqua Launchpad capture: where the names of the first row and column stand. Whole crop, nothing masked. The score is the text: it is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms, and the library sets a name about 1.5 pt higher than the capture has it (ink from 192 pt, captured from 193.5 pt). The icon above it, Apple's artwork, is outside the crop. The backdrop is painted by the fixture as measured.

comparisons.name: grid-label-first-backdrop-light
comparisons.description: The companion the harness requires beside grid-label-first-light: the same crop with the name masked (39% of the crop, text in the fallback font). What is left is the backdrop the fixture paints, so this scores only that the painted backdrop is the capture's, Aqua; it says nothing about the demo.

comparisons.name: grid-label-last-light
comparisons.description: The name under the 35th and last entry of the page, Image Capture, against the Aqua Launchpad capture: where the names of the fifth row and seventh column stand. Whole crop, nothing masked. The score is the text: fallback font, and the library's name stands about 2 pt higher than the captured one (ink from 856 pt, captured from 858 pt). The backdrop is painted by the fixture as measured.

comparisons.name: grid-label-last-backdrop-light
comparisons.description: The companion the harness requires beside grid-label-last-light: the same crop with the name masked (54% of the crop, text in the fallback font). What is left is the backdrop the fixture paints, so this scores only that the painted backdrop is the capture's, Aqua; it says nothing about the demo.

comparisons.name: grid-search-dark
comparisons.description: The search field on the demo's screen against the Dark Aqua Launchpad capture, with the magnifier and the placeholder masked (12% of the crop) and the backdrop painted as measured, as in grid-search-light.

comparisons.name: grid-pages-dark
comparisons.description: The two page dots, first page current, on the demo's screen against the Dark Aqua Launchpad capture. Nothing is masked; the backdrop is painted by the fixture as measured.

Masked (43% of the crop): the nine small icons, Apple's artwork. The name is text in the fallback font, about 1.5 pt higher than captured. Backdrop painted as measured, as in grid-folder-tile-light.

comparisons.description: As grid-folder-tile-dark with the name masked as well (49% of the crop: the small icons, Apple's artwork, and the name, text in the fallback font), to score the tile alone: its place in the grid, its size, corner and fill, Dark Aqua.

comparisons.name: grid-label-first-dark
comparisons.description: The name under the first application, App Store, against the Dark Aqua Launchpad capture. Whole crop, nothing masked: the score is the text, set in the fallback font and about 1.5 pt higher than captured, as in grid-label-first-light. Backdrop painted as measured.

comparisons.name: grid-label-first-backdrop-dark
comparisons.description: The companion the harness requires beside grid-label-first-dark: the same crop with the name masked (39% of the crop, text in the fallback font). It scores only that the backdrop the fixture paints is the capture's, Dark Aqua; it says nothing about the demo.

comparisons.description: The name under the last entry of the page, Image Capture, against the Dark Aqua Launchpad capture. Whole crop, nothing masked: the score is the text, set in the fallback font and about 2 pt higher than captured, as in grid-label-last-light. Backdrop painted as measured.

comparisons.name: grid-label-last-backdrop-dark

comparisons.name: folder-panel-top-left-light
comparisons.description: The top left corner of the open folder's panel on the demo's screen against the Aqua Launchpad-Folder capture: the panel's place at 137, 231 pt, which the demo's 17 applications in three rows give, its corner and its fill. Nothing is masked; no application is in the crop. The backdrop is painted by the fixture as measured, 120 pt beyond the crop, and blurred by the open folder.

comparisons.name: folder-panel-bottom-right-light
comparisons.description: The bottom right corner of the open folder's panel on the demo's screen against the Aqua Launchpad-Folder capture: the panel ends at 1543, 804 pt, three rows high. Nothing is masked: the third row ends after three applications, so no artwork is in the crop. Backdrop painted as measured and blurred by the folder.

comparisons.name: folder-title-light
comparisons.description: The folder's name, Other, above the panel, and the panel's top edge under it, against the Aqua Launchpad-Folder capture. Whole crop, nothing masked: the name is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms. Backdrop painted as measured and blurred by the folder.

comparisons.name: folder-title-drawing-light
comparisons.description: As folder-title-light with the name masked (29% of the crop, text in the fallback font), to score the panel's top edge at 231 pt and its fill under the name. What still differs is the backdrop along the crop's top: the capture's turns from blue to brown there, and the folder's blur, applied to the fixture's measured colours a second time, flattens the turn.

comparisons.name: folder-panel-top-left-dark
comparisons.description: The top left corner of the open folder's panel on the demo's screen against the Dark Aqua Launchpad-Folder capture. Nothing is masked; backdrop painted as measured and blurred by the folder, as in folder-panel-top-left-light.

comparisons.name: folder-panel-bottom-right-dark
comparisons.description: The bottom right corner of the open folder's panel on the demo's screen against the Dark Aqua Launchpad-Folder capture. Nothing is masked; backdrop painted as measured and blurred by the folder.

comparisons.name: folder-title-dark
comparisons.description: The folder's name, Other, above the panel, and the panel's top edge under it, against the Dark Aqua Launchpad-Folder capture. Whole crop, nothing masked: the name is set in the fallback font. Backdrop painted as measured and blurred by the folder.

comparisons.name: folder-title-drawing-dark
comparisons.description: As folder-title-dark with the name masked (29% of the crop, text in the fallback font), to score the panel's top edge at 231 pt and its fill under the name, Dark Aqua.
